sections.title: AI Services for New York Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for New York's world-leading healthcare ecosystem.

blocks.heading: NewYork-Presbyterian Academic Medical AI
paragraphs: NYP (Weill Cornell Medicine + Columbia University Irving Medical Center) — New York State's largest hospital system, consistently ranked among the US's top 10:

Clinical risk stratification at NYP scale: 30-day readmission, clinical deterioration early warning, and sepsis prediction across NYP's large Epic-integrated patient population — incorporating the complexity of NYP's tertiary and quaternary referral patient mix that creates higher-acuity clinical risk patterns than community hospitals.

Multilingual patient-facing AI: Patient navigation, appointment, and care coordination AI in multiple languages for NYP's extraordinarily diverse patient population — Spanish, Chinese, Russian, Haitian Creole, Korean, and Bengali are among the most commonly needed for NYC's multi-ethnic patient community.
Academic research AI: Clinical trial matching, cohort identification, and translational research ML for NYP's large NIH-funded research enterprise at Weill Cornell and Columbia.
Cost: $70,000–$190,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + NYC health data governance

blocks.heading: Memorial Sloan Kettering Oncology AI
paragraphs: MSK — the world's pre-eminent cancer center for over a century — is a ClickMasters healthcare reference:

Precision oncology prediction: ML integrating genomic sequencing, tumor imaging, and clinical history for MSK's precision oncology programs — treatment response prediction, immunotherapy candidate identification, and clinical trial eligibility determination.

Multidisciplinary tumor board support: AI for MSK's multidisciplinary tumor boards — synthesizing radiology, pathology, genomics, and clinical notes into structured case summaries that enable tumor board consensus more efficiently.

Cancer research AI at scale: Clinical and translational research ML for MSK's large federally-funded research programs — the single largest cancer research institution in the world by number of active clinical trials.
Cost: $75,000–$210,000 | Timeline: 16–32 weeks | HIPAA + IRB + FDA SaMD

blocks.heading: NYC Public Health AI
paragraphs: NYC Health + Hospitals (the US's largest municipal hospital system) and New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene:

NYC public health surveillance: Disease surveillance and outbreak detection AI for NYC DOHMH — the public health department that manages health crises for 8.3 million residents in the world's most densely populated major US city.

Social determinants integration: ML incorporating NYC's complex social determinants — housing instability (NYC's 500,000+ rent-stabilized apartments), food insecurity, and immigration status — into clinical risk models for NYC H+H's predominantly Medicaid and uninsured patient population.
Multilingual public health AI: Public health communication and outreach AI for NYC's 800-language community — the world's most linguistically complex public health challenge.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | NYC health data privacy

blocks.heading: New York Digital Health Community
paragraphs: New York's large digital health startup community — Hims & Hers (NYC operations), Carbon Health (NYC), Quartet Health (NYC), and the digital mental health and value-based care companies:

Digital behavioral health: AI for New York's large behavioral health technology community — mental health app analytics, teletherapy engagement prediction, and crisis risk assessment with NYS Mental Health Code privacy protections.

Value-based care technology: ML for New York's rapidly evolving value-based care market — ACO quality measure prediction, care gap identification, and population health analytics for DSRIP successor programs.

Social care integration: AI connecting clinical and social care for NYC's large community health organization network — connecting clinical findings to social service interventions for NYC's complex social needs population.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | HIPAA + NYS mental health law

sections.title: New York Healthcare AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for New York healthcare AI development.

blocks.heading: New York Mental Hygiene Law
paragraphs: New York's mental health information confidentiality requirements exceed HIPAA — ClickMasters designs NYC behavioral health AI with New York's specific mental health privacy protections.

blocks.heading: NYDOH health data governance
paragraphs: The New York State Department of Health has specific data governance requirements for health data used in research and quality improvement that differ from pure HIPAA requirements — ClickMasters designs NYC health data AI with NYDOH governance frameworks.

blocks.heading: NYC Local Law 144 for healthcare AI
paragraphs: Automated employment decision tools in NYC healthcare organizations must meet LL 144 bias audit requirements — ClickMasters designs NYC healthcare employment AI with LL 144 compliance.
